 1                      IT IS STIPULATED AND AGREED by and 
 2   between counsel for the Plaintiff and counsel for the
 3   Defendants that the videoconference deposition of
 4   ROBERT WILLIAMS may be taken in shorthand by Jessica M.
 5   Carter, a Registered Professional Reporter, Certified

 7   afterwards transcribed into typewriting, and the

10                         * * * * *
11                       ROBERT WILLIAMS,
12   of lawful age, being produced, sworn, and examined on
13   the part of the Plaintiff, and after responding "Yes"
14   to the oath administered by the court reporter, deposes
15   and says:
16                         * * * * *
17                        EXAMINATION
18   QUESTIONS BY MR. DAVIDSON:
19        Q    Good morning.  Can you state your name for
20   the -- introduce yourself on the record?
21        A    Robert Williams.
22        Q    And what is your current occupation?
23        A    I am a police officer for the City of Toledo.
24        Q    And what is your current assignment?
25        A    The domestic violence unit.
0006
 1        Q    And how long have you been with them?
 2        A    Approximately five years.
 3        Q    Were you with domestic -- the domestic
 4   violence unit in September of 2019?
 5        A    Yes.
 6        Q    On September 18th of 2019, were you at --
 7   were you at the -- the Johnson protest at
 8   Monroe and Summit area by the courthouse?
 9        A    Yes.
10        Q    Okay.  In advance of this deposition, did
11   you review any documents?
12        A    Not that I recall.
13        Q    Any videos?
14        A    Yes.
15        Q    What videos did you review?
16        A    I reviewed a video of the protest in the
17   intersection of Monroe and approximately Summit area.
18        Q    Was it an aerial video?
19        A    I believe one was a ground video and one
20   might have been an aerial video.
21        Q    Two videos total?
22        A    I believe so.
